response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux credentials, but he falls short on two hard requirements: his German is self-reported as basic (the role requires minimum C1), and his career shows no formal leadership, team management, or client-facing architectural consulting experience at the level this executive role demands. His technical depth is strong, but the profile is that of a hands-on individual contributor rather than a Head of Development.
strengths: Nearly 20 years of broad software development experience across web, embedded, and high-scale backend systems
Strong open-source track record (GISCollective founder, D-language libraries) and solid Linux background
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German proficiency is basic, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal experience leading teams, managing projects, or holding executive/leadership titles
No evidence of UML expertise, requirements management, or IT security/compliance advisory work; limited Python

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership and team management track record
Strong open-source and Linux engineering depth
